senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַט) a fraction, a small portion.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 353:12">Sifré Deut. 353</cite> <he>וכי כמה ארצות … פ׳ זה קטן</he> has Joshua conquered so many lands? Did he not conquer only this small portion (of the earth)?; Yalk. ib. 959 (not <he>פרטוס</he>).—[Tanḥ. Shof’tim 9 <he>פרטומין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01670"><he>פְּרוֹטוֹמִי</he></cite>.]
